description: This Java test class contains integration tests for the Loan Product API, specifically focusing on updating loan products with advanced payment allocation rules and interest calculation types. It uses RestAssured for API requests, JUnit 5 for testing, and custom helper classes for setup and assertions.

classes.name: LoanProductUpdateApiTest
classes.description: Contains setup methods and tests for updating loan products' advanced payment allocation rules and interest calculation types.

methods.name: setupTests
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured, authentication, and helper objects before all tests.

methods.name: loanProductModifyForAdvancedPaymentAllocationRuleTest
methods.description: Tests creating a loan product with a specific payment allocation rule, verifies it, updates the rule, and verifies the update.

methods.name: loanProductWithInterestCalculationTypeDailyModifyForAdvancedPaymentAllocationRuleTest
methods.description: Tests creating and updating a loan product with interest calculation type as daily and default payment allocation rule, and verifies changes.

methods.name: updateLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to update a loan product with new advanced payment allocation data.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with specific advanced payment allocations.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithInterestCalculationPeriodTypeDaily
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with daily interest calculation and specific advanced payment allocations.

methods.name: createDefaultPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Creates an AdvancedPaymentData object with specified future installment allocation rule and default payment order.

methods.name: getPaymentAllocationOrder
methods.description: Creates a list of PaymentAllocationOrder objects from given payment allocation types with ordered sequence.
